messages:
nate (Marketing): Quick heads-up — we confirmed APAC-friendly time for the webinar: Mar 31, 8:00 JST. Need a small promo bundle + an inbound routing map for SDRs. Low-effort, high-polish. :sparkles:

maya (Design): Happy to take. What exactly in the bundle? hero image, 3 social microcards, 1 email banner, and a simple diagram for inbound routing?

nate (Marketing): Exactly. Also a 1-slide claim card we can drop into the landing page (numbers come from the benchmark). Need two copy variants for A/B testing on social CTAs.

zoe (Growth): For CTAs: Variant A = "See how serving saves cost" Variant B = "How we cut token spend" — may want to test verbs. Also can we get localized text for JP/KR?

maya (Design): Okay. Deliverables (rough):
- hero_1200x628.png (web hero)
- social_card_1_1080x1080.png
- social_card_2_1080x1080.png
- social_card_3_1080x1080.png
- email_banner_600x200.png
- inbound_routing_diagram.svg (editable; flow with 3 touchpoints)
- claim_card_800x450.png + source figma frame
I'll drop a Figma link in 10. Need final copy + legal on the claim.

jen (Ops): Deadline? We push teaser on Mar 24 for APAC. Designers need final copy/by Mar 20 EOD to hit that.

nate (Marketing): Mar 20 EOD is fine. Zoe: can you own localized copy (JP + KR)?

zoe (Growth): Yep, will do. I'll ping native reviewers. ETA Mar 18.

maya (Design): Figma starter file here: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/redwood-webinar-teasers — frame names prefixed "APAC_teaser". Export guidance: PNG for social, SVG for diagram. Quick CSS-friendly color tokens only (no custom gradients).

evan (Brand): Heads-up on brand: avoid absolute comparative claims ("2x faster" or "2x cheaper") unless backed by a public benchmark. Use phrasing like "significantly lower per-token cost" or "reduced inference cost." Also ensure logo clearspace, use brand-accent-3 for CTA buttons.

nate (Marketing): We have a benchmark slide that shows median token cost. Want to reference that page as the source on the claim card. Legal sign-off needed on numeric phrasing.

legal-bot: Quick check: any direct comparative claims vs competitors require substantiation. For internal benchmark references, include a tooltip link to the benchmark doc (no competitor names). If you want the numeric "x%" callout, provide the benchmark export CSV and the date run.

maya (Design): Great — I'll design two versions of the claim card: one with qualitative phrasing and one with a numeric callout placeholder (e.g., "~30% lower per-token cost") so legal/ops can swap in verified numbers.

jen (Ops): Reminder: SDR routing map needs destinations mapped to trackable UTM parameters and which team owns the lead (Growth, AE, or Enterprise). Please add a small legend on the diagram.

maya (Design): Noted. Diagram will include nodes: Landing page -> Qualification form -> Auto-assign rules -> AE queue / Growth nurture / Enterprise SDR. I'll add color-coded UTMs in the legend and a tiny code snippet example for UTM params.

maya (Design): snippet for UTM example (will be on the diagram):
```
?utm_source=organic_social&utm_medium=teaser_social&utm_campaign=apac_webinar_mar31
```

zoe (Growth): Nice. Also add an arrow for "replay" flow — people who view replay should be routed to nurture only.

evan (Brand): Quick nit: use the brand-approved icons (icon-set v3). I'll attach the pack in the figma file.

nate (Marketing): Anything blocking legal sign-off? legal-bot?

legal-bot: Once you upload the benchmark CSV + run-date we can approve numeric callout. Qualitative phrasing is fine now. Also ensure no medical/financial guarantees in any copy.

maya (Design): Timeline check: I'll do first screens by Mar 16, iterate Mar 17–19, final exports Mar 20 AM. If copy/localization slips, the hero will be text-agnostic and we can overlay later.

zoe (Growth): I'll get JP/KR copy + reviewers by Mar 18. Tagging @sato and @minji for quick look.

evan (Brand): I'll review frames on Mar 17 and confirm color/typography. If we need to tweak buttons for contrast I'll flag then. :eyes:

nate (Marketing): Perfect. Thanks team — Maya, please post the Figma link update and a quick checklist once first pass is ready. :thumbsup:

maya (Design): Will do. Figma frame posted and comment thread started.
